about: PROPOSED, UNSIGNED. One Proofline task, XC-85: P9 (the bazaar discovery info in a 402 validates against the schema the endpoint ships with it) and P10 (the host's /.well-known/x402 manifest lists the paid URL on its own host and declares terms a live offer matches). Both come from a live run on 2026-10-25 where a seller's bazaar example sent `limit` as the string "3" while its own schema typed it integer, which no check caught. XC-36 (D1, signed) grades a facilitator's discovery API; it does not read a resource server's own bazaar extension or well-known manifest, so this does not duplicate it. P9 adds no request; P10 adds one GET per origin and only with --well-known. Owner's go, 2026-10-25T12:48Z, in chat: 'fix mcp and endpoints and then test'. Under D-AUTO-4 sys may batch-sign contracts covered by an owner go; nothing here binds until the owner key signs it into proofline.json.

tasks.title: P9 and P10: a seller's discovery metadata is consistent with its own schema and its live 402
tasks.description: src/x402conf/discovery.py: a dependency-free JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 subset validator (type, enum, const, properties, required, additionalProperties, patternProperties, items, prefixItems, length, pattern, numeric bounds, allOf/anyOf/oneOf/not, same-document $ref; other keywords listed as not graded). check_402 emits P9 when the PaymentRequired carries extensions.bazaar: info and schema present, $schema Draft 2020-12 when declared, no external $ref/$id, info validates against schema, info.input.type http or mcp. `x402conf resource --well-known` fetches each origin's /.well-known/x402 once (a 404 is not graded) and emits P10 (warning): resources listed are HTTPS on the host or a subdomain, the paid URL is listed, and every declared term (scheme, network, asset, payTo, atomic amount) matches a live offer. Catalogue entries with controls and faulty builds, SPEC, FIXES, COVERAGE and README rows.

criteria.statement: P9 passes an example that matches its schema and catches a type mismatch, an external $ref and a missing required field
P10 passes a manifest that matches the live offer, catches an unlisted URL, an off-host entry, stale terms and a different atomic amount, does not grade a 404, and fetches each origin once
P9 and P10 are in the catalogue with controls, faulty builds and fix sections, and the TypeScript catalogue matches

verifier.cmd: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c 'import sys; from x402conf.spec import CATALOG; m={"P9", "P10"}-set(CATALOG); print("missing:", sorted(m)); sys.exit(1 if m else 0)' && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest tests.test_offline.Offline.test_credibility_matrix_complete tests.test_offline.Report.test_every_catalog_check_has_a_fix_section tests.test_offline.Report.test_ts_catalog_matches_spec_catalog

criteria.statement: resource mode stays read-only: every request it sends, the manifest included, is a GET
Every changed file is inside this task's scope

stop_rules: If a criterion cannot pass, STOP and report what blocks it, what was tried and what is needed. Never weaken a criterion, skip a test or raise a timeout to make it pass.
Never send anything but GET in resource mode, and never fetch a $ref or a listed resource while validating.
